summary: Customers logged out right after changing their password
description: After a password change users are logged out and have to log in again.

summary: Session keeps expiring on the iPhone app
description: iOS users get logged out every few minutes when they come back to the app.

summary: Microsoft SSO login fails with redirect error
description: Azure AD sign in returns a redirect uri mismatch after the domain change.

summary: SAML login broken for Okta customers
description: SAML assertion validation is failing for Okta since this morning.

summary: 2FA codes not accepted
description: Users say their authenticator codes are rejected even when typed correctly.

summary: Customer billed twice for one order
description: A customer was charged two times by Stripe for a single order.

summary: Ugandan shoppers see prices in dollars
description: Users in Uganda are shown USD instead of UGX at checkout.

summary: M-Pesa refund not completed
description: Refund issued to an M-Pesa customer is still pending after a week.

summary: Refunding one item refunded the whole order
description: Partial refund returned the full amount to the customer.

summary: DHL label error for long street address
description: Cannot create DHL label, carrier rejects the address line as too long.

summary: Printed UPS labels come out empty
description: Printing a UPS shipping label produces a blank page.

summary: Freight rate wrong for 45kg parcel
description: A heavy parcel of 45kg was quoted the same shipping rate as a 30kg parcel.

summary: DHL surcharges not reconciled against orders
description: Remote area surcharges from the DHL invoice are not matched to orders in invoice reconciliation.

summary: Parcel marked delivered while still out for delivery
description: Tracking shows delivered but the courier has not arrived yet.

summary: Outlook users not receiving order emails
description: Order confirmation emails land in junk for Outlook and Hotmail.

summary: Reset password email not delivered
description: Forgot password flow sends nothing to the user.

summary: No SMS updates for Kenyan phone numbers
description: Customers with +254 numbers are not getting SMS delivery notifications.

summary: Android users get each notification twice
description: Every push notification arrives two times on Android devices.

summary: Searching cafe does not match Café products
description: Products with accented characters are missing from search results.

summary: Search slow during Black Friday
description: The search page times out under heavy traffic during the sale.

summary: Merchant orders list takes forever to load
description: Large merchants wait a long time for the orders page.

summary: Order export only contains first 10000 orders
description: The CSV export is truncated for big merchants.

summary: Garbled characters when opening export in Excel
description: Customer names with special characters are broken in the CSV export.

summary: API timeouts every night
description: Database CPU spikes at night and the API starts timing out.
